problem: Learners need a tutor that adapts to them over time. DeepTutor is an AI learning companion that answers from your own documents and tracks your progress.

stack.frontend: Next.js web app, plus desktop app previews
stack.backend: Python 3.11+ with FastAPI, Typer CLI, aiohttp, httpx and Pydantic
stack.database: SQLite (optionally PocketBase) and FAISS and LightRAG for retrieval
stack.ai: OpenAI SDK and many providers, multi-agent collaboration, RAG, MCP, optional Claude Agent SDK
stack.deploy: Docker and docker-compose (multi-stage image), a deeptutor CLI, and desktop downloads

whatsNew: It is agent-native: a CLI and agents can drive the tutor, and it builds a long-term learning record with notebooks, quizzes and video lessons. Optional modules are installed separately.
